purpose: Select one shared Pure PA SVD residual strength without using held-out labels
source_split: released validation images, partitioned by index before development/holdout scoring; the initial VOC21 full-split exploratory curve had already been inspected
shared_gamma_criterion: maximize the unweighted mean development mIoU difference from fixed CSA mean across VOC21, VOC20 and ADE20K; ties choose smaller gamma
shared_lambda_criterion: maximize the unweighted mean development mIoU of weighted CSA across the same three splits; ties choose smaller lambda
reported_holdout_comparison: shared selected gamma against fixed CSA mean and gamma=1 on all three holdouts
full_validation_curves: exploratory, not independent confirmation after parameter choice
blinding_limit: Because initial VOC21 full-split results were inspected before freezing this index partition, the VOC21 holdout is not fully blinded to the research process. All parameter selection computations use development indices only.
